installedTest6.scope: descriptor-listed payload only; maintenance resources and extra files not certified

installerReview.processScope: Every process whose executable path begins with the product root plus directory separator, case-insensitive; not just a fixed executable-name allowlist.
installerReview.ownershipCheck: Queries process owner SID; failed owner query or a different user stops maintenance.
installerReview.terminationFor18u: For a same-user matching process still running, Kill() then waits up to 5 seconds. The graceful -stop branch applies to standard yimecore, not yimecore-18u.
installerReview.excludedFromThatKillBranch: Host executable outside the product root, even if it loads the product DLL; other product roots and package-directory executables are not included by this path predicate.
installerReview.unreadableProcessPath: Path read errors are skipped by installer; therefore this loop is not proof of complete process visibility.
installerReview.order: Product/registration ownership checks, then stop matching product processes, then Wait-ProductFiles, then unregister profile/TIP/COM and delete product files.
installerReview.fileCheck: All files under product root including .setup; File.Open(Open, ReadWrite, None), immediately disposed.
installerReview.onFileFailure: Does not unregister/delete past the file gate; Silent throws. Non-silent mode offers Retry/Cancel and can loop if the user chooses Retry.

processObservation.method: existing Python ctypes with Windows PSAPI and read-only process handles; no debug privilege elevation
limitations: Snapshot is non-atomic and processes/modules may change.
Protected or inaccessible processes are not proven clear.

protection.scope: Known paths and selected keys only; file hashes do not certify all filesystem metadata unchanged.
